en: The image is a vintage-style postcard featuring a black-and-white illustrated portrait of a man in military uniform, identified as 'Comte de Custine'. Below the portrait is a block of French text detailing his biography and military achievements, as well as his fate during the French Revolution. The style and presentation suggest it is part of a historical or commemorative postcard series.
